stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class): percentages from College Navigator, exact counts from the NCES file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal (12,521 applied, 6,372 admitted = 51%, 1,223 enrolled = 19% of admits; enrolled = 1,222 full-time + 1 part-time). No Common Data Set was found: Providence's institutional research page lists 'Common Data Set (Coming Soon)', so international applicants and admits, in-state/out-of-state counts, early decision counts, waitlist, GPA and the admission-factor grid are not shown. SAT/ACT percentiles cover enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (SAT 19%, ACT 5%). Providence is test-optional, so these ranges describe a minority of the class. Undergraduate enrollment (4,236) and the nonresident count (71) are IPEDS fall 2024 total undergraduates (4,229 are degree-seeking; the College Scorecard figure).

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.
